items.title: Closures of irreducible sets and the union description of the irreducible components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the basic properties of irreducible components (author lemma at source lines 1102-1113, label lemma-irreducible): closures of irreducible subsets are irreducible, components are closed, every irreducible subset lies in an irreducible component, and the space is the union of its irreducible components. The proof (source lines 1115-1139) mirrors the connectedness lemma but with a Zorn argument in place of the common-point trick: it takes a maximal element of the irreducible subsets containing the given one, using that the union of a totally ordered family of irreducible subsets is irreducible (proof lines 1125-1136), and then applies the result to singletons for assertion (4). The list is the reference point for the chapter's later results on sober spaces and spectral spaces. H2.
